steps.say: TNF blockers come in five forms and only one suits pregnancy. Certolizumab is the form without the Fc piece, so the placenta cannot ferry it across. The other four cross in late pregnancy. Biologic choice in a young woman requires this distinction.
steps.tx: Tumour necrosis factor (**TNF**, a master inflammatory cytokine) inhibitors span chimeric infliximab, human adalimumab and golimumab, pegylated Fab **certolizumab** pegol, and soluble receptor fusion **etanercept**. Certolizumab lacks an Fc portion and cannot bind the neonatal Fc receptor (**FcRn**, the placental antibody ferry), so transfer across trimesters is near zero. The other four cross the placenta in late pregnancy, so certolizumab is the TNF choice when conception is planned.

steps.say: Every biologic start requires tuberculosis screening with IGRA and chest film. Monoclonal antibodies are stronger reactivators of tuberculosis than etanercept. One month of prophylaxis precedes the first dose. Skipping this screen risks disseminated disease.
steps.tx: Latent tuberculosis screening with interferon gamma release assay (**IGRA**, a blood test of TB memory) or tuberculin skin test plus chest radiograph is mandatory before any biologic or targeted synthetic DMARD. Reactivation risk is highest with monoclonal anti TNF antibodies and lower with **etanercept** (a soluble receptor). At least **1 month** of prophylactic therapy precedes biologic initiation, because reactivation under TNF blockade disseminates fast.

vis.alt: Airborne tuberculosis transmission with granuloma formation and latent versus active infection outcomes.
vis.caption: Latent infection is contained in granulomas until TNF blockade releases it. Screening with IGRA and film precedes every start. Credit: Wenping Gong and Xueqiong Wu.

steps.say: Hepatitis B screening needs three markers before rituximab. Positive surface antigen or core antibody indicates prophylaxis with entecavir or tenofovir. Protection runs 12 to 18 months past depletion. Reactivation above 40 percent is the price of skipping it.
steps.tx: Hepatitis B screening with HBsAg, anti-HBc, and anti-HBs is mandatory before immunosuppression. B cell depletion with **rituximab** (anti CD20 antibody) in HBsAg or anti-HBc positive patients reactivates hepatitis B in above **40 percent**, often fatally. Prophylaxis with **entecavir** or tenofovir starts before rituximab and continues at least **12 to 18 months** after depletion, because B cells return slowly over 6 to 9 months.

vis.alt: Hepatitis virus features with serology phases and pathology across infection stages.
vis.caption: Core antibody positivity indicates prophylaxis even when surface antigen is negative. Entecavir cover runs past B cell return. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: IL-6 blockade erases CRP and fever as warning signs. Tocilizumab and sarilumab are silencers of the liver signal within days. Sepsis is then diagnosed clinically, not by labs. Bowel perforation at diverticular sites is the surgical trap.
steps.tx: Blocking the IL-6 receptor with **tocilizumab** or sarilumab removes the liver signal of infection. Hepatic **CRP** (C reactive protein) production depends on IL-6, so levels turn undetectable within days of the first dose even during bacteraemia, and fever plus CRP cannot be trusted for sepsis. Lower intestinal **diverticular** perforation (silent colonic rupture) is the feared complication, presenting late exactly because CRP cannot rise.

points: CRP falls to zero within days
left.title: On IL-6 blockade

steps.say: Abatacept removes the second signal of T cell activation. CD80 and CD86 are met by a decoy with higher affinity than CD28. Without co-stimulation, the T cell is never fully awake. It suits patients where TNF blockade is unsafe.
steps.tx: **Abatacept** joins the outer portion of cytotoxic T lymphocyte antigen 4 (**CTLA-4**, the natural off switch) to an IgG1 Fc tail. The fusion grips **CD80** and **CD86** on antigen presenting cells tighter than CD28 ever can, removing the co stimulatory second signal of T cell activation. Without that signal the T cell stays anergic, so abatacept suits seropositive RA with lung disease or lymphoma history where TNF blockade is unsafe.

steps.say: Rituximab deletes B cells from pre-B to mature stages while sparing plasma cells. Two 1000 mg infusions two weeks apart are the course that depletes for 6 to 9 months. Seropositive patients respond best. Vaccines and hepatitis cover are arranged before the first infusion.
steps.tx: **Rituximab** is a chimeric anti **CD20** antibody that depletes pre-B and mature B lymphocytes while sparing pro-B cells and antibody secreting plasma cells. Dosing is two **1,000 mg** intravenous infusions **14 days** apart with methylprednisolone cover, and depletion lasts **6 to 9 months**. Efficacy is strongest in seropositive disease, because autoantibody producing lineages depend on CD20 positive precursors.

steps.say: JAK inhibitors are pills that jam many cytokine signals at once. Selectivity differs by molecule, but shingles follows all of them. Tofacitinib, baricitinib, and upadacitinib each require zoster vigilance. Clots and lipids are monitored alongside.
steps.tx: Pills that jam Janus kinase (**JAK**, intracellular cytokine signal enzymes) silence many pathways at once: **tofacitinib** hits JAK1 and JAK3, **baricitinib** hits JAK1 and JAK2, and **upadacitinib** is selective for JAK1. All three stop **STAT** phosphorylation downstream of IL-6, interferons, and gamma chain cytokines, trading injections for tablets. Herpes **zoster** (shingles) reactivation is characteristic of the class, so recombinant zoster vaccine precedes therapy whenever timing allows.

steps.say: Biosimilars are equivalent copies that cut cost without cutting clinical effect. Efficacy, safety, and immunogenicity are all equivalent to the originator product. Indications are extrapolated across inflammatory diseases. The rheumatoid hand figure shows exactly where these drugs act.
steps.tx: **Biosimilars** are biological copies with equivalent efficacy, safety, and immunogenicity to the originator, without clinically meaningful difference. Indications extrapolate across inflammatory diseases, so one biosimilar serves RA, spondylitis, psoriasis, and bowel disease cohorts together. The deformed hand with pannus cytokines and **DMARD** (disease modifying drug) action sites shows the pathways these agents interrupt, from TNF to JAK.

vis.alt: Rheumatoid hand deformities with pannus cytokines and DMARD action sites.
vis.caption: Each DMARD class interrupts the pannus cytokine network at a different node. Biosimilars match originators at every node. Credit: StewardMD.
